content:
maya: FYI CS-2387 — ACME reporting intermittent 502s hitting /v1/generate since ~2024-09-20T16:02Z. Sample curl reproducer below, small % of requests fail with 502, most are ok.

maya: curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -d '{"prompt":"hello","stream":false}'

dmitri: any deploys or infra changes around that time?

infra-bot: no deploys detected in the last 60m. autoscaler/worker events present.

sara: looking at edge logs (eu-west-1) — spike of 502s 16:01:58–16:06:00. Envoy has repeated entries: "upstream reset: connection failure, reason: connection termination" and some STREAM_RESET (0x2). This looks like upstream ejection during a model swap.

amanda: can you paste a trace id + envoy log lines when you have them?

maya: trace: trc_9f3a2d11 sample envoy lines:

"[2024-09-20T16:01:59.987Z] "POST /v1/generate" 502 - "upstream reset: connection failure" x-request-id=trc_9f3a2d11 upstream_info=ded-34
"[2024-09-20T16:02:00.003Z] "POST /v1/generate" 200 - x-request-id=trc_9f3a2d12 upstream_info=ded-34"

maya: notice 1st attempt reset, next attempt succeeds — same session/conn reused for a different request type.

dmitri: hypothesis: midproxy/frontdoor connection reuse + backend drain during model rollout. If upstream is being drained (model swap), in-flight streams can get hard-terminated and Envoy will surface 502 for some request windows.

ops-bot: autoscaler: model-swap initiated for model-id "m-gen-large-v2" on ded-34 at 2024-09-20T16:01:58. Rollout strategy=graceful-drain (but drain_timeout seems low)

sara: repro steps we've validated in staging:
1) start a streaming/long request (curl -N with chunked body)
2) trigger model swap on target ded pool
3) observe a subset of concurrent requests get 502 while connections get RESET

sara: reproducer (streaming):

curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d @- <<'EOF' --no-buffer
{"prompt":"a"}
# keep socket open, send periodic whitespace every 2s to simulate streaming
EOF

amanda: short-term mitigation: bump drain_timeout and disable idle connection reuse across a hop during model-swap window.
Applying hotfix: set frontdoor config `proxy.keepalive_reuse=false` and increase `upstream.drain_timeout=20s` for eu-west-1, then rolling apply.

infra-bot: config applied to frontdoor eu-west-1 (3 nodes): proxy.keepalive_reuse=false -> 3/3 success, upstream.drain_timeout updated

customer-success: ACME confirms error rate dropped to ~0 within 10m after config change. :thumbsup:

dmitri: longer term: add test coverage for draining long-lived streams, add metrics for `drain_inflight_count`, and change rollout to mark existing keepalive connections as "do not reuse" during swap.

maya: I'll open RFC + follow-up ticket (INF-4721) to track changes, and send formal postmortem to CS.

customer-success: notified customer with mitigation steps and ETA for RFC. They accepted the temporary workaround.

amanda: leaving note: watch for any side-effects on load (more TCP conns) — we should monitor connection churn metric over next 24h.

sara: closing thread for now; will update when RFC lands.
